summary: The end of the sample fact output: processor counts, cores and vcpus, product info, Python interpreter details, SELinux status, service manager (systemd), SSH host keys, swap, system, user info, virtualization role and type, and gather_subset. It notes that you can then reference a disk's model in a template.
questions: Which fact tells me how many vCPUs a host has?
How can I check whether SELinux is enforcing from facts?
How do I detect whether a host is a virtual machine and which hypervisor it uses?
Which fact shows the init system, such as systemd?
How do I see which Python interpreter the remote host used?
